adjacency_data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Identify neighbors
adjacency_data = adjacency_data.drop_duplicates('borough')
adjacency_data = adjacency_data.pivot(index='borough', columns='neighbor', values='neighbor')
adjacency_data = adjacency_data.fillna('')

    neighbors = adjacency_data.loc[row['borough']].dropna()

else:
